summary.intent: Review, clean up, and ship all phase 40 work (desktop vault settings integration) on the cipher-box branch, then resolve all open PR review comments.
summary.outcome: Code was cleaned up (4 fixes applied), 8 unit tests added for `apply_versioning()`, a PR was created (FSM1/cipher-box#424), and all 3 CodeRabbit review threads were resolved with targeted fixes (timeout guards on IPFS/IPNS calls, pruning-during-cooldown fix, VERIFICATION.md update).

repo: Default vault settings live in `cipherbox_core::default_vault_settings()`, not in fuse/constants.rs — dead DEFAULT_* constants had accumulated there.
KeyState fields consistently use RwLock, so RwLock<VaultSettings> is idiomatic here.
DeleteBehavior is intentionally stringly-typed to handle raw user JSON input validation.
auth.rs commands (load_vault_settings, complete_auth_setup) are pure integration glue with Tauri state, IPFS, IPNS, ECIES — not unit-testable without full runtime mocking.
apply_versioning() in fuse/src/helpers.rs is the only pure-logic function in the phase 40 diff and the only realistic unit-test target.
FUSE mount code (fuse/mod.rs) requires a live mount — struct field assignments there cannot be unit-tested.

code.finding: Had a custom clamp() helper that duplicated u32::clamp() from std (available since Rust 1.50).
IPFS/IPNS calls in complete_auth_setup() had no timeout, could hang and stall login — timeout guards added per CodeRabbit review.

apply_versioning() had a bug: lowering max_versions wouldn't take effect during an active cooldown because pruning only ran after the cooldown check. Fixed to always prune regardless of cooldown state.
apply_versioning() takes 10 parameters — extracted from inline code, a struct wrapper was deemed premature at this stage.

workflow: Three-agent parallel review (reuse, quality, efficiency) is effective for catching distinct categories of issues without overlap.
Codecov patch coverage comments are a useful forcing function but many Tauri command lines are structurally untestable — acknowledge this explicitly rather than chasing the number.
CodeRabbit threads can surface real bugs (pruning-during-cooldown, missing timeouts) worth fixing even when overall review quality is mixed.
Stale worktrees from agent runs should be cleaned up after PR creation to avoid branch clutter.

friction: First /simplify invocation was interrupted by the user before agents completed, requiring a full restart with additional context.
Codecov patch coverage report flagged 42 lines at 0% but 39 of those (auth.rs integration glue) are structurally untestable — metric creates noise without actionable signal.
open_items: apply_versioning() 10-parameter signature — a struct wrapper was deferred as premature but should be revisited if the function grows.
auth.rs timeout values are hardcoded — should be configurable or at least defined as named constants rather than inline literals.
Integration/E2E test coverage for auth.rs commands (load_vault_settings, complete_auth_setup) requires a full IPFS+Tauri runtime harness — deferred indefinitely.
